business_overview.one_sentence: LEE KEE is a Hong Kong listed non-ferrous metal distributor/trader with small property rental and investment asset exposure.

segments.name: metal trading
segments.description: Trading of zinc, zinc alloy, nickel, aluminium and other non-ferrous metals across Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan and Southeast Asia.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025/2026, management discussion and segment information

segments.name: property holding and rental
segments.description: Hong Kong investment properties generating rental income.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025/2026, investment properties note and other income note

business_overview.revenue_model: High turnover, thin gross margin metal trading; revenue is tied to commodity sales and requires inventory plus receivable financing.
business_notes: Gross margin was about 5.1% in FY2025/2026.
Working capital is concentrated in inventory and trade receivables.
Reported FY2025/2026 profit was helped by disposal and foreign exchange gains while recent multi-year cash generation was weak.

gaps: Cash is not split by listed parent, Hong Kong operating entities, Mainland China subsidiaries and other overseas subsidiaries.
No explicit restricted cash line was identified in the reused fact extraction; absence of a separate restricted cash line is not treated as proof that all cash is detachable.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; total purchase of property, plant and equipment plus intangible additions is used as a conservative proxy.
Whether investment properties can be sold without operational disruption is not fully confirmed.
